bio_html:
Kelly Langdon has been associated with the Queensland Eye Institute since 2004 in a General Management consulting capacity. Kelly’s qualifications included a Bachelor of Human Resource Management and Economics.

Kelly enjoys the variety and scope of working with the Queensland Eye Institute; it provides the opportunity to bring commercial business to the not for profit sector
